label: B25-RX-CPU-VISIBLE-OBSERVABILITY-BATCH
title: Correlate bridge, response-path, firmware dispatch and TX acceptance for physical JTAG-UART RX
writes: scripts/test_registry.json only by the integrator after both lanes merge
scope: Run two independent write lanes from one frozen base. T-013 adds read-only hardware path observation and vendor-timed verification. T-014 adds firmware-visible getc/dispatch/putc diagnostics and rotating bounded output. Merge each lane only into a temporary batch candidate, then run their affected L0-L2 union. No functional datapath fix is permitted until the first divergent boundary is demonstrated.

new_read_only_offsets.0x18: last matched JTAG bridge DATA response with RVALID=1, low 32 bits
new_read_only_offsets.0x20: last matched router/PoC DATA response with RVALID=1, low 32 bits
new_read_only_offsets.0x28: last matched core dmem DATA response with RVALID=1, low 32 bits
new_read_only_offsets.0x30: path event counts and sticky fault flags
new_read_only_offsets.0x38: accepted JTAG TX write count/seen/last byte

frozen_observability_abi.path_count_format: bits31:24 bridge valid-event count, 23:16 PoC valid-event count, 15:8 dmem valid-event count; bit2=dmem sticky fault, bit1=PoC sticky fault, bit0=bridge sticky fault, bits7:3=0; valid-event counts wrap modulo 256 and empty DATA responses do not increment or overwrite raw values
frozen_observability_abi.tx_event_format: bits31:16 bridge/Avalon accepted DATA-write count, bit8 TX-seen, bits7:0 last accepted byte; count wraps modulo 65536 and does not claim vendor FIFO enqueue when overflow is possible
frozen_observability_abi.reset: all new hardware observation registers, counts and sticky flags reset to zero
frozen_observability_abi.sampling: each stage uses one pending token created only by an accepted CPU-originated read of UART DATA 0x09000000 and cleared by its matched response fire, including fault responses; raw/count update only when matched rdata[15]=1; observation must not drive ready/valid, request, response or architectural state

firmware_output_contract.line_limit: Every emitted diagnostic line must be shorter than the 64-byte vendor TX FIFO; do not emit multiple diagnostic pages in one burst.
rotation: RXDBG %08X %08X\r\n keeps the existing read-count and RX-event fields (25 bytes)
RXPATH %08X %08X %08X %08X\r\n reports bridge, PoC, dmem raw response and packed path counts (44 bytes)
RXCPU %08X %08X %08X %08X\r\n reports getc, dispatch, putc and hardware TX packed events (43 bytes)
firmware_output_contract.schedule: startup emits RXDBG without advancing autonomous state; the first 0x40000-poll autonomous observation also emits RXDBG, then autonomous calls rotate RXPATH -> RXCPU -> RXDBG; manual d always emits RXDBG and never reads or advances the autonomous page
firmware_output_contract.software_reset: page index, getc-valid count/last raw, dispatch count/code/byte and putc write/drop counts initialize to zero at _start
firmware_output_contract.compatibility: Existing RXDBG first two fields retain their meaning; parsing must use the explicit page prefix.

acceptance.lane_independence: T-013 and T-014 stay within disjoint declared writes and make no functional response-path change.
acceptance.hardware_lane: Vendor-timed single-byte tests prove bridge->PoC->dmem response payload equality, exactly-once counts, reset/fault behavior and read-only status mapping.
acceptance.firmware_lane: Boot image contract and CAL-WAIT full-SoC tests prove page rotation, getc/dispatch/putc accounting and unchanged p/?/d/Z behavior with every line below 64 bytes.
acceptance.combined: On the merged batch SHA, affected L0-L2 and existing vendor/full-SoC regressions pass; each injected byte has an identical full 32-bit vendor DATA word at bridge/PoC/dmem and correct software dispatch/TX accounting. In the controlled one-byte vendor model this word is 0x0000A400|byte, including RVALID, TX-not-full and AC status bits.
acceptance.stop_rule: Any pre-existing source failure must identify the first divergent boundary and stop before a functional RTL edit.

resource: Analysis and small Icarus runs are light. Any Verilator/full-SoC job obtains the local resource lock and uses a unique task output path. T-013 and T-014 may not run heavy jobs concurrently. This batch does not use GamePC, Quartus, JTAG or the board.
forbidden_regions: functional ready/valid or response datapath changes
rtl/lcvex_core.sv, rtl/lcvex_catapult_soc_coh.sv and cache functional logic
QSF, SDC, platform manifest or T-010 SOF
QEMU, Flash/JIC/EPCQ, reset, power or board actions

integration.focused: PASS; status ABI, observer unit and vendor bridge
integration.heavy: PASS on clean r4: response trace 4/4/4 with full-word equality and vendor CAL-OK/CAL-WAIT/CAL-FAIL full-SoC SOC_B25_ALL_PASS
